sourceEvidence.title: Quality Manager
sourceEvidence.quote:
* Knowledge of ISO9001 and DMAIC process tools
* Machine and process capability studies, analysis of results, SPC, and other problem solving techniques
* Thorough knowledge of FMEA, APQP, PPAP, MSA, problem solving, continuous improvement, TQM and GD&T
* Guide activities of internal processes for many different products
* Work independently
* Oral and written communication skills
* Knowledge of MS office applications
**ALE Competencies:** Customer Focus, Drive for Results, Adaptability, Effective Communication
**Education and Experience**
**Education Requirements** : Four year technical degree in engineering, manufacturing, or quality
**Experience Requirements** : Five years of experience in a technical capacity (engineering, manufacturing, or quality)
**Certification Requirements** : ASQ and Green Belt certification preferred
